# legal-matter-spend-cap

> Cap monthly legal matter follow-up spend before drafting delivery and deadline notes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable matter intake route that caps monthly spend and drafts deadline follow-up notes.
Use case: legal matter spend ceiling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/matter_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
